excerpt: The Conus experiment studies coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering in four 1 kg germanium spectrometers ... operated inside an optimized shield at the Brokdorf nuclear power plant ... In the final phase of data collection at this site, the constraints ... were improved by an order of magnitude.
title: Final CONUS results on coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering at the Brokdorf reactor
